contexts.text: Not only to darken, but also to obliterate and dissipate (truth). Signified.
That interior worship was obliterated. Signified.
The sense of the letter is (then) obliterated...
The former things are (then) almost obliterated.
Then all the fraternity, and all the friendship, which had been of the external man, are obliterated on both sides...
The Knowledges of the interior things of man are almost obliterated.
These things are with him like things forgotten and obliterated.
It is believed that the things which (man no longer remembers) are completely obliterated and cast out; but they are not obliterated...
That all the Sensitive of truth was obliterated. Signified, Explained.
Was first obliterated with the Israelitish people...
After the science of correspondences... was obliterated...
The most singular things which have entered the memory... are never obliterated.
As faith separated has obliterated it...
Because evil obliterates truth.
With these, (faith alone) is obliterated; nay, is to be completely obliterated.
Thereby have obliterated... the idea of infancy concerning God.
That science... with the Israelitish nation was completely obliterated.
When the significations of these things had been obliterated...
When anything (is written) from the external man alone... it is obliterated of itself.
This was to be obliterated.
That... evils are obliterated when the man is good.
It is not that the evil is obliterated, but that the Lord operates good...
The memory of particulars is never obliterated in the other life...
Afterwards this (faculty) was so obliterated that...
What conjugial love is, is almost obliterated...
